notes.title: My new game NetDive is out NOW!
notes.content: [p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718870/NetDive/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]My new game NetDive is out NOW![/p][p][/p][p]It's a very experimental incremental game meant to validate the state of my framework for making Autopanic, also surprisingly story rich if you can believe it.[/p]

notes.title: v1.1.0 & macOS
notes.content:
[b]v1.1.0[/b] (87c4a3a92)

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Add macOS version (Apple Silicon only).
[*]Finally got time to do some proper artwork for the game, it ain't much but it's honest work.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an age old issue where the pursuit projectile will still have light active even when dynamic lighting is set to off.
[*]Resolved an issue that prevents Light Weight mode from being active alongside HDR, they are now compatible. But that still doesn't mean it's best using it because the UI during gameplay will be way dimmer than the gameplay visual.
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Shop and loadout menu now shows equipment previews.
[*]Rebalanced abilities, namely remove the leveling system of weapon modules because it is just rather out of place.
[*]Added several sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Officially Steam Deck verified!
notes.content:
Not really surprising since the game always targeted Steam Deck, but at least it is official now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43336634/522cc104c2eda839a4d7c244ba5598e52df1bf6d.png[/img]

Can't believe someone at Valve took their time to test this small game (quite a big list of checklist) but for whoever is involved, thank you!

notes.title: Help wanted for fixing game freezing problem and v1.0.7 hotfix
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I've got multiple reports on game freezes upon opening the game.

I've tried a lot of setup including clean state installation all cannot reproduce the problem, so I'll be needing help to fix this one. If your configuration leads to this problem, please send Unity player log (at [u]Users\[Username]\AppData\LocalLow\ChosenConcept\Autopanic Zero\Player.log[/u]) to me using the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeTz7Y2b_mKe03paVKjKlAUoEuatAGFmzXjcjQZh9Ntk_rGqg/viewform]Bug Report Form[/url] and I should be able to locate the problem.

Thanks in advance!

In the meantime I pushed a v1.0.7 hotfix to potentially resolve this issue, but I don't think it'll actually work.

notes.title: Autopanic Zero is now released!
notes.content:
So um, a bit abrupt but anyways Autopanic Zero is now released!

I've been having a two week long headache so please don't expect hotfixes to happen timely enough and I'm sorry about it, but at least for now I hope you all enjoy the game and I need some sleep. Ciao!
